test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

 All cats are dogs.

 No cat is a horse.

 Conclusions:

 (I): No dog is a horse.

 (II): No horse is a cat.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
** Statements:**

 All cats are dogs.

 No cat is a horse.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bea39813f032f05be4e2683fe34dbf6e20e1ed7c42b2bbedfe9fb59661770aa6.png] 

** Conclusions:**

 (I): No dog is a horse - False(As there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

 (II): No horse is a cat - **True**( As No cat is a horse, it implies that no horse is cat).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
